title: Immoderate
summary: IMMOD'ERATE, adjective [Latin immoderatus; in and moderatus. See Moderate.] Exceeding just or usual bounds; not confined to suitable limits; excessive; extravagant; unreasonable; as immoderate demands

inlines.v: IMMOD'ERATE, adjective [Latin immoderatus; in and moderatus. See Moderate.] Exceeding just or usual bounds; not confined to suitable limits; excessive; extravagant; unreasonable; as immoderate demands; immoderate passions, cares or grief.
